Resolution criteria:
- "Yes": Wins if BTC-USD on Coinbase reaches a trade price of $67,000 or above at any point during August 2026 (UTC).
- "No": Wins if BTC-USD on Coinbase does not reach $67,000 at any point during August 2026 (UTC).

Clarifications:
- "Reaches $67,000" means the BTC-USD spot price on Coinbase trades at or above $67,000.00 at any single moment within the calendar month of August 2026 (00:00:00 UTC on August 1, 2026 through 23:59:59 UTC on August 31, 2026), not only at the market's settlement time.
